svg.title: Aetherwake — Ionia native visual V3 versus V4, east and west
svg.desc: Four authentic original, unchanged 960x640 native Godot First Wake PNG frames at fixed Ender/Ionia anchors. PR321 V3 files came from its private Git commits, PR323 V4 from verified native runner run 39665845509, code head 3070d507301935e56558040104cda9d24feb0252. Cropping occurs only in the SVG display window, not in the embedded PNG bytes. Source v3 and v4 art remain unapproved; relative aesthetic improvement requires creator decision.
